title: A look at Eko, whose Arkansas "capture factory" creates digital product catalogs intended to serve as training data for retail-focused AI models (Sarah Nassauer/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Sarah Nassauer / Wall Street Journal: A look at Eko, whose Arkansas “capture factory” creates digital product catalogs intended to serve as training data for retail-focused AI models — In an Arkansas ‘capture factory,’ hand models and food stylists are preparing for the future of shopping
contentText:
